# `adt export`

Export local files to SAP (deploy serialized objects)

Aliases: `deploy`

```bash
adt export [options] [files...]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                                                                      | Default |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `[files...]` | Specific files to deploy (e.g., zage_fixed_values.doma.xml). Omit to deploy all. |         |

**Options**

| Option                              | Description                                                                           | Default   |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-s, --source <path>`               | Source directory containing serialized files                                          | `.`       |
| `-f, --format <format>`             | Format plugin: abapgit \| @abapify/adt-plugin-abapgit                                 | `abapgit` |
| `-t, --transport <request>`         | Transport request for changes                                                         |           |
| `-p, --package <package>`           | Target package for new objects                                                        |           |
| `--types <types>`                   | Filter by object types (comma-separated, e.g., CLAS,INTF)                             |           |
| `--dry-run`                         | Validate without saving to SAP                                                        | `false`   |
| `--activate`                        | Activate objects after deploy (use --no-activate to skip)                             | `true`    |
| `--unlock`                          | Release locks with handles persisted by this CLI before saving                        | `false`   |
| `--verify`                          | After deploy, verify each object ended up in the correct package on SAP               | `false`   |
| `--abap-language-version <version>` | ABAP language version for new objects (2=keyUser, 5=cloud). Required for BTP systems. |           |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
